exposure: Birth defects during the whole of pregnancy
cohort: 23,649 fetuses delivered in a hospital in China from January 2017 to December 2020, including 485 cases of birth defects
finding: Preterm birth, cesarean section, scarred uterus, and low birth weight were significantly associated with birth defects during the whole of pregnancy, while cesarean section, gestational hypertension, and low birth weight were significantly associated with perinatal birth defects.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with both birth defects during the whole of pregnancy and perinatal birth defects.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was significantly associated with both birth defects during the whole of pregnancy and perinatal birth defects.
